questions.q: What is the Spanish word for 60?
questions.explanation: Sesenta is 60 — it hides seis (6). Setenta (70) hides siete (7).

questions.q: Every tens word from 40 to 90 shares the same ending. What is it?
questions.explanation: cuarenta, cincuenta, sesenta, setenta, ochenta, noventa — all end in -enta.

questions.q: How do you write 47 in Spanish?
questions.explanation: Tens word first (cuarenta), then y, then the ones (siete): three separate words.

questions.q: Numbers 16-29 fuse into one word (dieciséis, veintidós). What about numbers from 31 to 99?
options: They fuse into one word too
They are written as three separate words joined by y
They are written with a hyphen
questions.explanation: The fusing stops at treinta. From 31 up it is always three words: treinta y uno, noventa y nueve — and no accent marks.

questions.q: In the guess-my-number game, your partner says 'menos.' What should you do?
questions.explanation: Menos means 'less' — the secret number is lower, so guess down. Más would mean guess up.

questions.q: Which word means exactly 100, all by itself?
questions.explanation: Cien is exactly 100. Ciento is used only for 101-199 (ciento uno = 101).
